name: jasper-deploy
description: Design, compile, and deploy JasperReports artifacts to JasperReports Server over REST v2: scaffold JR7 jrxml from SQL, lint/compile/deploy reports and dashboards, manage datasources, Domains, OLAP, themes, input controls, scheduling, permissions, and STAGE/PROD promotion. Includes a doc-derived reference library covering JRS 4.7 through 10.1 (version deltas, upgrade/migration playbook, authentication, hardening, Domains, Visualize.js).
